setMarker.find: You will be in four groups, and each group will move to a specific corner of the labelled card.
At each specific corner you have selected, you will represent the main reason people move to cities and you will discuss why your chosen card attracts people to urban areas.
In groups, you will read the card and discuss how urbanisation affects that area
Each group will write three key impacts on chart paper and place it in that corner
The class does a gallery walk, moving around the room to read and compare each group’s findings.
